title: AWS Lambda function URL to Amazon DynamoDB
description: Create Lambda function with a function URL that inserts an item into the Amazon DynamoDB table.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The Lambda function URL exposes an HTTP(s) endpoint. When an HTTP `POST` request with the right payload is sent to this endpoint the Lambda function is invoked and inserts an item into the Amazon DynamoDB table (named `users`).

testing.headline: Testing
text: See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
